name: rain barrel
hint: A hollowed log under the shelter's edge. It fills with rain in 12 hours.

log: You hollow a log with the axe and set it under the edge of the shelter.
Hour by hour the axe hollows the log. You stand it where the rain runs off.
A hollow log, set on end where the shelter drips.

start.label: set out
log: You tip the barrel upright under the edge of the shelter.
You set the barrel where the rain will run into it.

collect.label: drink
log: Rainwater, soft and cold. You drink your fill.
You drink from the barrel. It tastes of wood and sky.
Sweet rainwater, as much as you want.
